name: The car's drive status and speed reach the dashboard
step: Check the drive status and speed telemetry
rationale:
gripora-firmware sends the car's drive state on the removed heli governor sensors: TELEM_DRIVE_STATUS (93; CRSF 0x1205 U16, S.Port 0x5125) packs the drive aids flags, GYRO OFF, DRIFT, LAUNCH, DRIVE AIDS OFF, reversing and speed known, and TELEM_DRIVE_SPEED (94; CRSF 0x1206 S16, S.Port 0x5126) is the wheel speed in 0.1 km/h, negative in reverse. Both replace altitude and variometer in the firmware's default sensor list. The dashboard's governor tile and artificial horizon were flight features; the governor subtype now shows the drive aids (text/driveaids.lua), and the built-in themes show the top speed where they showed the altitude.

The harness drives the real lib/drive_status.lua (the word reduced to one state, most urgent first), the sensor tables (the default list equals the firmware's, both protocols map 93/94, and the CRSF status is decoded as a U16: the old governor entry's U8 would throw the rest of a custom-telemetry frame off), widgets/dashboard/context.lua with lib/live_sensors.lua (speed in km/h, nothing without a speed source or a link), lib/flight_stats.lua (top speed and fastest reverse), and the driveaids and governor tiles (word, level colour, a theme's colour and threshold, and a repaint when only the colour changes). Its self-test ranks ABS releasing below DRIFT in a copy of lib/drive_status.lua and requires a check to go red.
